nested_lists.name: deposit_accounts

encoding_variations: Current vs average balance are distinct on a VOD (the average balance is the anti-"just deposited" control) — keep both per account; never collapse to one balance
Direct delivery is stated as a checkbox ("Sent directly to lender"), a stamp, or an implied transmittal — capture whichever appears; the independence signal is easily lost to the catch-all
Institution names on the request block vs the certification block can differ (branch vs legal entity) — read the certifying entity for depository_institution_name

open_questions.q: loans_secured_by_or_held_at_institution — second nested list. The VOD's loan section can surface undisclosed debts or pledged assets (real mortgage value).
options: add it as a second flat list
open_questions.recommendation: keep only deposit_accounts now — no rule consumes the loan section yet, and a second list is ~5 extra plumbing sites; flatten the presence signal into pledged_or_restricted_accounts for now and revisit when an undisclosed-debt rule exists GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): BUILD IT — LP-437 made nested lists cheap (one declaration + the generic mechanism); the one-list-budget / defer / no-consumer concern is overturned. Build as flat_row; the per-rule consumer is separate follow-up.

open_questions.q: Signatures degraded to presence strings — applicant_authorized / institution_representative_signed degrade signature to str (no coercer).
open_questions.recommendation: keep a presence/label string; add signer name only if a rule needs it

notes: No rules read this document today (rule floor is empty); fields are justified by identity, disambiguation, PII, and processor use. A VOD (typically Fannie Mae Form 1006 / Freddie Mac Form 90) is a bank-certified statement of a borrower's deposit balances; its value hinges on the average balance (seasoning) and direct-delivery independence.

Layout: the request block (lender, applicant, authorization signature) is at top, the certified accounts in the middle, and the institution certification (rep name/title/signature/date, direct-delivery) at bottom. "Average balance for previous two months" maps to average_balance, not current_balance.
account_number_masked (nested) is already in the 7-field _PII_FIELDS registry, pre_masked=true; nothing new needs registration.
